title: First-principles calculation of a 1T-VS2/graphene composite as a high-performance anode material for lithium- and sodium-ion batteries
content:
Energy Adv., 2025, 4,1345-1355
DOI: 10.1039/D5YA00110B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ahmed Jaber Hassan, Kar Tim Chan, Kean Pah Lim, Nurisya Mohd Shah, Umair Abdul Halim, Nurfarhana Mohd Noor, Wan Mohammad Zulkarnain Abdul Razak
First-principles calculations show that VS2/graphene heterobilayers exhibit metallic conduction and ultrafast ion transport, reducing Li+/Na+ barriers to 0.11/0.16 eV and offering high capacities with low OCV, ideal for fast-charging batteries.
